arStrings.szText: {c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and shatters into {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} small explosions on impact, dealing {c_number}{payload:SHRAPNEL_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage each.

{c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} becomes a {c_important}Disciple{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} follows and orbits around you, dealing {c_number}{payload:ORBIT_IMPACT_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and attacking {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|%|]{/c} faster.
{c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} mortars {c_number}[SF_23]{/c} hammers to the ground, dealing {c_number}{payload:PAYLOAD_LOBBED}{/c} damage in an area.
Casting {c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} reduces its cost by {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_29}{/c}  seconds, up to {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} times.
Hitting enemies with {c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} increases its damage by {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%x|]{/c} up to {c_number}{SF_31}{/c} times, for {c_number}{SF_39}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} now Slows enemies by {c_number}[SF_33*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_36}*100|%+|]{/c} increased Cast Speed and its hammers travel {c_number}[{SF_38}*100|%+|]{/c} faster.
